  AVG(CASE WHEN f.symbol IS NULL THEN r.pct_change ELSE NULL END) AS avg_abs_return_without_8k
FROM r
LEFT JOIN f ON r.symbol = f.symbol AND r.date = f.filed_at
) as limited limit 1000

select * from (
WITH n AS (
  SELECT symbol, headline, published_at::date AS date
  FROM news
  WHERE published_at::date BETWEEN '2021-11-17' AND '2026-11-16'
)
SELECT n.symbol, n.headline, p.close / lag(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date) - 1 AS pct_change
FROM n
JOIN prices p ON n.symbol = p.symbol AND n.date = p.date
ORDER BY n.date, n.symbol
) as limited limit 1000

select * from (
WITH latest_news AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT symbol
  FROM news
)
SELECT t.symbol, t.name, p.close AS latest_close
FROM tickers t
JOIN latest_news ln ON t.symbol = ln.symbol
JOIN prices p ON t.symbol = p.symbol AND p.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM prices WHERE symbol = t.symbol)
ORDER BY t.symbol
) as limited limit 1000

select * from (
WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.symbol, f.filed_at, t.sector
  FROM filings f
  JOIN tickers t ON f.symbol = t.symbol
  WHERE f.form_type = '4' AND f.filed_at BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT t.sector, COUNT(f.symbol) AS num_form_4_filings
FROM f
JOIN tickers t ON f.symbol = t.symbol
GROUP BY t.sector
ORDER BY num_form_4_filings DESC
) as limited limit 1000
